rows.description: trzsz-ssh ( tssh ) is an ssh client designed as a drop-in replacement for the openssh client. It aims to provide complete compatibility with openssh, mirroring all its features, while also offering additional useful features. Such as login prompt, batch login, remember password, automated interaction, trzsz, zmodem(rz/sz), udp mode like mosh, etc.
trzsz ( trz / tsz ) is a simple file transfer tool, similar to lrzsz ( rz / sz ), but compatible with tmux.
在 Mac 下，实现与服务器进行便捷的文件上传和下载操作
trzsz-go is the go version of trzsz, makes all terminals that support local shell to support trzsz ( trz / tsz ).
